lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Hello, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I'm an operator of the Central Government's Intelligence Department.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I'm not reaching out to you for an urgent task.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Instead, it's a personal request.
Personal request?

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Not long ago, something strange was caught on a surface-based drone.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: It looked like something sneaking around with a hood on,

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: and it looked very much like a human.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Everyone in the company dismissed it as a bag moving with the wind,

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: but I'm certain that it's a human.
Why?

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: The way it moved looks very familiar.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Also, a Commander by the name of Jane Miller

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: was considered dead after attempting to run away. Ring any bells?
Could it be...

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: It was moving just like her

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: and it just so happens that the location is close to where she disappeared.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: If possible, can you investigate the area once more?

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: But of course, it could be my misjudgment...
I'll look into it.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: This is a personal request, so the company can't know about this.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I'd appreciate it if you can keep this a secret.
Can't it be a formal request?

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Normally, it could.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: But so far, searching for missing persons

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: results in failure 90% of the time.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: And the other 10% of the time, they find a dead body.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Unless there's a valid reason like last time,

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: it's highly unlikely to convert it into a formal task.
I see.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I'm sending you the coordinates.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Please find her.
